致同学
sentences.zh: 随着新学期的开始，你们将进入小学阶段的最后一年。在这本书里，你们将和老朋友们一起了解丰富多彩的中外文化，学习独立思考和多角度地看待事物。想学好英语，一定要多听、多说、多读、多看、多写。愿你们和书里的小主人公一起享受小学生活的美好时光。

sentences.en: (title
You should visit there!
Read and answer:

1. What did you learn about the Jinggang Mountains? The Jinggang Mountains are a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage Site. There is a Jinggangshan Revolution Museum with old books and photos about the Red Army. You can climb the mountains, see bamboo forests and waterfalls, and eat delicious pumpkin soup and red rice. It is only 1.5 hours from the airport by bus.
sentences.zh: 井冈山是联合国教科文组织世界文化遗产。那里有一座井冈山革命博物馆，陈列着关于红军的旧书籍和照片。你可以攀登山峰，欣赏竹林和瀑布，还能品尝美味的南瓜汤和红米饭。从机场乘车只需约1.5小时。

sentences.en: 2. What does the word "must-see" mean in the first review? "Must-see" means that the place is so special and interesting that everyone should visit it. It is a place you cannot miss.
"Must-see"
sentences.zh: 的意思是这个地方非常特别、有趣，每个人都应该去参观。这是一个不容错过的地方。

sentences.en: 3. Do you want to go to the Jinggang Mountains after reading the reviews? Why? Yes, I do. I want to go there because the views are wonderful and the food is delicious. I also want to learn more about the history of the Red Army.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想去。因为那里的风景很壮观，食物也很美味。我还想更多地了解红军的历史。

A wonderful place! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My trip to West Lake was amazing! I walked around the lake for hours and saw beautiful lotus flowers. I also ate famous West Lake fish in vinegar sauce at a nice restaurant. The view was wonderful. You should visit there!

sentences.en: ② Write captions for each place and talk about them.
sentences.zh: ② 为每个地方写说明文字并进行讨论。

sentences.en: Guangzhou
I took a trip to Guangzhou and visited the Guangdong Science Centre.
sentences.zh: 我去广州旅行，参观了广东科学中心。

sentences.en: Shaoxing 绍兴
Mount Huangshan 黄山
John: Where did you go, Zhang Peng and Amy?
sentences.zh: 约翰：张鹏和艾米，你们去哪里了？

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: I took a trip to Guangzhou.
John: What did you do?
Zhang Peng: ...
John: I went to Hangzhou and Shaoxing. I went to visit the former home of Lu Xun. He was a famous writer.
sentences.zh: 约翰：我去了杭州和绍兴，我去参观了鲁迅的故居。他是一位著名的作家。

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: Yes, he was. He wrote a lot of great books.
sentences.zh: 张鹏：是的，他确实是。他写了很多伟大的著作。

sentences.en: Captions（
Guangzhou
sentences.zh: 广州： I took a trip to Guangzhou and visited the Guangdong Science Centre. It was very interesting! 我去广州旅行，参观了广东科学中心，非常有趣！

sentences.en: Shaoxing
sentences.zh: 绍兴： I went to Shaoxing and visited the former home of Lu Xun. He was a famous writer and wrote many great books. 我去了绍兴，参观了鲁迅的故居。他是一位著名的作家，写了很多伟大的著作。

sentences.en: Mount Huangshan
sentences.zh: 黄山： I climbed Mount Huangshan and watched the beautiful sunrise. The view was amazing! 我爬了黄山，观看了美丽的日出，景色真是太壮观了！

sentences.en: Zhang Peng（
sentences.zh: 补充）： I visited the Guangdong Science Centre. I saw many interesting science exhibits. It was amazing! 我参观了广东科学中心，看到了很多有趣的科学展品，真是太棒了！
Amy（ 补充）： I climbed Mount Huangshan. The view from the top was wonderful. I took many beautiful photos there. 我爬了黄山，山顶的景色非常壮观，我在那里拍了很多漂亮的照片。

sentences.en: A What amazing places do you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道哪些奇妙的地方？

sentences.en: 🔴 Let's talk
Zhang Peng is talking with John. Listen and choose. 🎧
sentences.zh: 张鹏正在和约翰交谈。听录音并选择。🎧

sentences.en: What day is it?
A. Friday.　　B. Saturday.　　C. Sunday.
sentences.zh: A. 星期五。　　B. 星期六。　　C.星期日 。

sentences.en: What will Zhang Peng do now?
A. He'll meet a friend.　　B. He'll answer a call.　　C. He'll have a class.
sentences.zh: A. 他要去见一位朋友。　　B. 他要去接电话。　　C. 他要去上课。

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: Hi, Leo! How was your weekend?
sentences.zh: 张鹏：嗨，利奥！你的周末过得怎么样？

sentences.en: Leo: Not too bad, thanks. And you?
Zhang Peng: It was great! I climbed the Great Wall.
Leo: Wow! The Great Wall is amazing.
sentences.zh: 利奥：哇！长城真是太壮观了。

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: Yes, it is! It's about 21,000 kilometres long. What did you do, Leo?
sentences.zh: 张鹏：是啊！它全长约21,000公里。你做了什么，利奥？

sentences.en: Leo: I visited the "Gingerbread House" last Saturday.
sentences.zh: 利奥：我上周六参观了"姜饼屋"。

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: What did you do there? Eat gingerbread?
sentences.zh: 张鹏：你在那里做了什么？吃姜饼吗？

sentences.en: Leo: Ha! Ha! No! It's a beautiful train station in New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 利奥：哈！哈！不是！那是新西兰的一座美丽的火车站。

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: That sounds interesting. Please send me some pictures.
sentences.zh: 张鹏：听起来很有趣。请给我发一些照片吧。

sentences.en: What did the boys do last weekend?
sentences.zh: 男孩们上周末做了什么？

sentences.en: What facts do you learn from their conversation?
sentences.zh: 你从他们的对话中了解到哪些事实？

sentences.en: 🔴 Interview and report
What do you often do at the weekend? What did you do last weekend?
sentences.zh: 你周末经常做什么？你上周末做了什么？
姓名　　周末经常做的事　　上周末做的事
约翰　　我经常在家附近踢足球。　　我上周六下了中国象棋。

sentences.en: John often ... at the weekend. But last weekend, he ...
sentences.zh: 约翰经常在周末……。但上周末，他……

sentences.en: Listen and choose:
C. Sunday.
C. He'll have a class.
What did the boys do last weekend? Zhang Peng climbed the Great Wall last weekend. Leo visited the "Gingerbread House", a beautiful train station in New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 张鹏上周末爬了长城。利奥参观了"姜饼屋"，那是新西兰的一座美丽的火车站。

sentences.en: What facts do you learn from their conversation? The Great Wall is about 21,000 kilometres long. The "Gingerbread House" is a beautiful train station in New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 长城全长约21,000公里。"姜饼屋"是新西兰的一座美丽的火车站。

sentences.en: Interview and report 示例： John often plays football near his home at the weekend. But last weekend, he played Chinese chess.
sentences.zh: 约翰经常在周末去家附近踢足球。但上周末，他下了中国象棋。

sentences.en: 自己的示例： I often read books at the weekend. But last weekend, I visited the science museum with my family. It was very interesting.
sentences.zh: 我周末经常读书。但上周末，我和家人参观了科学博物馆，非常有趣。

sentences.en: ③ Make your holiday scrapbook.
sentences.zh: ③ 制作你的假期剪贴簿。
示例剪贴簿内容（杭州+绍兴之旅）：

sentences.en: Hangzhou
🗓️ Day 1 We went boating and took nice photos.
sentences.zh: 我们去划船，拍了很多漂亮的照片。

sentences.en: We walked to the West Lake.
🗓️ Day 2 We went to a famous restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我们去了一家著名的餐厅。

sentences.en: We drank Longjing tea, ate Dongpo pork and Jiao Hua Ji.
sentences.zh: 我们喝了龙井茶，吃了东坡肉和叫化鸡。

sentences.en: We climbed Baochu Hill and watched the sunrise.
sentences.zh: 我们爬了宝叔山，观看了日出。

sentences.en: We saw lots of fish in Fish Viewing at the Flower Pond.
sentences.zh: 我们在花港观鱼观赏了许多鱼。

sentences.en: Shaoxing
🗓️ Day 3 We visited the former home of Lu Xun and the Herb Garden.
sentences.zh: 我们参观了鲁迅故居和百草园。

sentences.en: Lu Xun was a famous writer. He wrote a lot of great books.
sentences.zh: 鲁迅是一位著名的作家，他写了很多伟大的著作。

sentences.en: ④ Share your scrapbook in class.
sentences.zh: ④ 在课堂上分享你的剪贴簿。

sentences.en: I had great fun with my family last summer holidays. We visited ...
sentences.zh: 上个暑假我和家人玩得非常开心，我们参观了……

sentences.en: Self-assessment
I can list some amazing places and talk about them.
sentences.zh: 我能列举一些奇妙的地方并进行介绍。

sentences.en: I can describe what I did in a trip and say why it was special.
sentences.zh: 我能描述旅行中做的事情，并说明旅行的特别之处。

sentences.en: I can share my experience and feelings about a trip.
sentences.zh: 我能分享旅行的经历和感受。

sentences.en: I can identify the structure of a travel review and write my own review.
sentences.zh: 我能识别旅行评价的结构，并写出自己的旅行评价。

sentences.en: Share your scrapbook

I had great fun with my family last summer holidays. We visited Hangzhou and Shaoxing. On Day 1, we went boating on the West Lake and took many nice photos. On Day 2, we climbed Baochu Hill and watched the sunrise. It was amazing! We also ate delicious Dongpo pork and drank Longjing tea. On Day 3, we went to Shaoxing and visited the former home of Lu Xun. We learnt a lot about his life and great books. It was such a wonderful trip!
sentences.zh: 上个暑假我和家人玩得非常开心。我们参观了杭州和绍兴。第一天，我们在西湖上划船，拍了很多漂亮的照片。第二天，我们爬了宝叔山，观看了日出，真是太壮观了！我们还吃了美味的东坡肉，喝了龙井茶。第三天，我们去了绍兴，参观了鲁迅故居，了解了他的生平和伟大著作。这真是一次美好的旅行！

sentences.en: My last trip to Sanxingdui was great! In the Sanxingdui Museum, I saw strange masks, the "big guy" statue and a life-size "fruit" tree lamp.
sentences.zh: 我上次去三星堆的旅行真是太棒了！在三星堆博物馆里，我看到了奇异的面具、"大立人"雕像和一棵真实大小的"果树"灯。

sentences.en: Some believed people from Sanxingdui were aliens. But it's not true. They might eat hotpot three thousand years ago, just like we do today.

sentences.en: (Chen Li, history teacher)
🟠 The pearl of Hangzhou

I visited the West Lake last autumn. On the first night, my friends and I watched the moon rising from a boat on the lake. We ate mooncakes and drank Longjing tea. The next day we walked along the lake. It was such a nice trip.
sentences.zh: 去年秋天，我参观了西湖。第一晚，我和朋友们坐在湖上的船里，欣赏月亮升起。我们吃了月饼，喝了龙井茶。第二天，我们沿着湖边散步。这真是一次美好的旅行。

sentences.en: (Jessica, nurse)
A What amazing places do you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道哪些奇妙的地方？

sentences.en: 🔴 Let's talk
Zhang Peng is talking with John. Listen and choose. 🎧
sentences.zh: 张鹏正在和约翰交谈。听录音并选择。🎧

sentences.en: What day is it?
A. Friday.　　B. Saturday.　　C. Sunday.
sentences.zh: A. 星期五。　　B. 星期六。　　C.星期日 。

sentences.en: What will Zhang Peng do now?
A. He'll meet a friend.　　B. He'll answer a call.　　C. He'll have a class.
sentences.zh: A. 他要去见一位朋友。　　B. 他要去接电话。　　C. 他要去上课。

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: Hi, Leo! How was your weekend?
sentences.zh: 张鹏：嗨，利奥！你的周末过得怎么样？

sentences.en: Leo: Not too bad, thanks. And you?
Zhang Peng: It was great! I climbed the Great Wall.
Leo: Wow! The Great Wall is amazing.
sentences.zh: 利奥：哇！长城真是太壮观了。

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: Yes, it is! It's about 21,000 kilometres long. What did you do, Leo?
sentences.zh: 张鹏：是啊！它全长约21,000公里。你做了什么，利奥？

sentences.en: Leo: I visited the "Gingerbread House" last Saturday.
sentences.zh: 利奥：我上周六参观了"姜饼屋"。

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: What did you do there? Eat gingerbread?
sentences.zh: 张鹏：你在那里做了什么？吃姜饼吗？

sentences.en: Leo: Ha! Ha! No! It's a beautiful train station in New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 利奥：哈！哈！不是！那是新西兰的一座美丽的火车站。

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: That sounds interesting. Please send me some pictures.
sentences.zh: 张鹏：听起来很有趣。请给我发一些照片吧。

sentences.en: What did the boys do last weekend?
sentences.zh: 男孩们上周末做了什么？

sentences.en: What facts do you learn from their conversation?
sentences.zh: 你从他们的对话中了解到哪些事实？

sentences.en: 🔴 Interview and report
What do you often do at the weekend? What did you do last weekend?
sentences.zh: 你周末经常做什么？你上周末做了什么？
姓名　　周末经常做的事　　上周末做的事
约翰　　我经常在家附近踢足球。　　我上周六下了中国象棋。

sentences.en: John often ... at the weekend. But last weekend, he ...
sentences.zh: 约翰经常在周末……。但上周末，他……

sentences.en: Listen and choose:
C. Sunday.
C. He'll have a class.
What did the boys do last weekend? Zhang Peng climbed the Great Wall last weekend. Leo visited the "Gingerbread House", a beautiful train station in New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 张鹏上周末爬了长城。利奥参观了"姜饼屋"，那是新西兰的一座美丽的火车站。

sentences.en: What facts do you learn from their conversation? The Great Wall is about 21,000 kilometres long. The "Gingerbread House" is a beautiful train station in New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 长城全长约21,000公里。"姜饼屋"是新西兰的一座美丽的火车站。

sentences.en: Interview and report 示例： John often plays football near his home at the weekend. But last weekend, he played Chinese chess.
sentences.zh: 约翰经常在周末去家附近踢足球。但上周末，他下了中国象棋。

sentences.en: 自己的示例： I often read books at the weekend. But last weekend, I visited the science museum with my family. It was very interesting.
sentences.zh: 我周末经常读书。但上周末，我和家人参观了科学博物馆，非常有趣。

sentences.en: ③ Make your holiday scrapbook.
sentences.zh: ③ 制作你的假期剪贴簿。
示例剪贴簿内容（杭州+绍兴之旅）：

sentences.en: Hangzhou
🗓️ Day 1 We went boating and took nice photos.
sentences.zh: 我们去划船，拍了很多漂亮的照片。

sentences.en: We walked to the West Lake.
🗓️ Day 2 We went to a famous restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我们去了一家著名的餐厅。

sentences.en: We drank Longjing tea, ate Dongpo pork and Jiao Hua Ji.
sentences.zh: 我们喝了龙井茶，吃了东坡肉和叫化鸡。

sentences.en: We climbed Baochu Hill and watched the sunrise.
sentences.zh: 我们爬了宝叔山，观看了日出。

sentences.en: We saw lots of fish in Fish Viewing at the Flower Pond.
sentences.zh: 我们在花港观鱼观赏了许多鱼。

sentences.en: Shaoxing
🗓️ Day 3 We visited the former home of Lu Xun and the Herb Garden.
sentences.zh: 我们参观了鲁迅故居和百草园。

sentences.en: Lu Xun was a famous writer. He wrote a lot of great books.
sentences.zh: 鲁迅是一位著名的作家，他写了很多伟大的著作。

sentences.en: ④ Share your scrapbook in class.
sentences.zh: ④ 在课堂上分享你的剪贴簿。

sentences.en: I had great fun with my family last summer holidays. We visited ...
sentences.zh: 上个暑假我和家人玩得非常开心，我们参观了……

sentences.en: Self-assessment
I can list some amazing places and talk about them.
sentences.zh: 我能列举一些奇妙的地方并进行介绍。

sentences.en: I can describe what I did in a trip and say why it was special.
sentences.zh: 我能描述旅行中做的事情，并说明旅行的特别之处。

sentences.en: I can share my experience and feelings about a trip.
sentences.zh: 我能分享旅行的经历和感受。

sentences.en: I can identify the structure of a travel review and write my own review.
sentences.zh: 我能识别旅行评价的结构，并写出自己的旅行评价。

sentences.en: Share your scrapbook

I had great fun with my family last summer holidays. We visited Hangzhou and Shaoxing. On Day 1, we went boating on the West Lake and took many nice photos. On Day 2, we climbed Baochu Hill and watched the sunrise. It was amazing! We also ate delicious Dongpo pork and drank Longjing tea. On Day 3, we went to Shaoxing and visited the former home of Lu Xun. We learnt a lot about his life and great books. It was such a wonderful trip!
sentences.zh: 上个暑假我和家人玩得非常开心。我们参观了杭州和绍兴。第一天，我们在西湖上划船，拍了很多漂亮的照片。第二天，我们爬了宝叔山，观看了日出，真是太壮观了！我们还吃了美味的东坡肉，喝了龙井茶。第三天，我们去了绍兴，参观了鲁迅故居，了解了他的生平和伟大著作。这真是一次美好的旅行！

B What makes a trip special?

sentences.en: 🔴 Let's talk
Binbin and Sarah meet Amy at school. Listen and write T (True) or F (False). 🎧
sentences.zh: 彬彬和莎拉在学校遇到了艾米。听录音，写T（正确）或F（错误）。🎧

sentences.en: Amy went to Hainan. ( )
The weather was good in Guiyang. ( )
Amy: Where did you go over the summer holidays, Binbin?
sentences.zh: 艾米：彬彬，你暑假去哪里了？

sentences.en: Binbin: I went to Xi'an with my family.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：我和家人去了西安。

sentences.en: Sarah: I like Xi'an very much. What did you do there?
sentences.zh: 莎拉：我非常喜欢西安。你们在那里做了什么？

sentences.en: Binbin: We ate some famous Xi'an noodles. Then we went to see the Terracotta Warriors.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：我们吃了一些著名的西安面条，然后去参观了兵马俑。

sentences.en: Sarah: Wow! I really want to go there! How was it?
sentences.zh: 莎拉：哇！我真的很想去那里！那里怎么样？

sentences.en: Binbin: Amazing! There are over seven thousand clay warriors and one hundred horses.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：太令人惊叹了！那里有七千多个陶制武士和一百匹马。

sentences.en: Amy: I saw pictures on the internet. What else did you do?
sentences.zh: 艾米：我在网上看过图片。你们还做了什么？

sentences.en: Binbin: Well, we walked around the old city and rode bikes on the old city wall.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：嗯，我们在古城里漫步，还在古城墙上骑了自行车。

sentences.en: Amy: That sounds great fun!
sentences.zh: 艾米：听起来真是太有趣了！

sentences.en: 💬 Where did Binbin go?
💬 What made his trip special?
sentences.zh: 💬 是什么让他的旅行变得特别？

Where did you go over the Labour Day holiday?
sentences.zh: 劳动节假期你去哪里了？

sentences.en: Tianjin. I ate the famous Goubuli baozi. They were good! I also watched a xiangsheng show. It was very funny.
sentences.zh: 天津。我吃了著名的狗不理包子，味道很好！我还看了一场相声表演，非常有趣。

sentences.en: I went to Dunhuang. I saw many beautiful wall paintings ...
sentences.zh: 我去了敦煌，看到了许多美丽的壁画……

What made his trip special? He ate famous Xi'an noodles, visited the Terracotta Warriors, walked around the old city and rode bikes on the old city wall.

We think the trip to Tianjin was special because we ate the famous Goubuli baozi and watched a funny xiangsheng show.

sentences.en: 🟠 A magical island

On Easter Island, I saw huge statues called Moai. The Rapa Nui people made them thousands of years ago. I loved the food on the island. The locals cooked fresh food on rocks! We had fish. It was so delicious!
sentences.zh: 在复活节岛，我看到了巨大的雕像，叫做"摩艾"。拉帕努伊人在几千年前建造了它们。我非常喜欢岛上的食物。当地人在岩石上烹饪新鲜食物！我们吃了鱼，真是太美味了！

sentences.en: (Lucy, 10-year-old student)
🟠 An unusual "table"
I climbed many mountains on my trips, but Table Mountain in South Africa was a special one. Its name comes from its top. It is flat like a table! But I found it only looks flat from one side.
sentences.zh: 我在旅途中爬过很多山，但南非的桌山是一座特别的山。它的名字来源于它的山顶——像桌子一样平坦！但我发现它只从一面看起来是平的。

sentences.en: I went to the top by cable car. The first cable car opened in 1929. The view was so amazing!
sentences.zh: 我乘缆车到达山顶。第一条缆车于1929年开通，那里的景色真是太令人惊叹了！

I climbed many mountains on my trips, but Table Mountain in South Africa was a special one. Its name comes from its top. It is flat like a table! But I found it only looks flat from one side.

sentences.zh: 项目：展示学校活动的精彩瞬间

sentences.en: 1 Mr Jones and Binbin are talking about school events. Listen and fill in the table. 🎧
sentences.zh: 琼斯老师和彬彬正在谈论学校活动。听录音，填写下面的内容。🎧

sentences.en: 2 Here are photos from the school events. Look and role-play.
sentences.zh: 这里有一些学校活动的照片。看图并进行角色扮演。

sentences.en: Miss White: Are these photos from the Double Ninth Festival this year?
sentences.zh: 怀特老师：这些是今年重阳节的照片吗？

sentences.en: Binbin: Yes, they are.
Miss White: Did the old people have a good time?
sentences.zh: 怀特老师：老人们玩得开心吗？

sentences.en: Binbin: Yes, they did.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：是的，他们玩得很开心。

sentences.en: Miss White: What did they like about it?
sentences.zh: 怀特老师：他们喜欢什么？

sentences.en: Binbin: ...
Miss White: Did you ...?
Binbin: ...
am/is—was　　are—were
clean—cleaned　　paste—pasted　　play—played
visit—visited　　watch—watched
do—did　　go—went　　make—made
read—read　　see—saw
Listen and fill in:
·去了一家老人院 ·cleaned 房间 ·在窗户上贴剪纸 ·made 饺子 ·大声朗读 old 报纸

sentences.zh: · 邀请爷爷奶奶到学校 ·sang and danced 欢迎他们 ·观看老照片

sentences.en: Role-play
Miss White: What did they like about it? Binbin: They liked watching the students play and sing. They were very happy.
Miss White: Did you make anything for them? Binbin: Yes, we did. We made paper cuttings and gave them to the old people as gifts.
sentences.zh: 怀特老师：他们喜欢什么？ 彬彬：他们喜欢看同学们表演和唱歌。他们非常开心。
怀特老师：你们有没有为他们做些什么？ 彬彬：是的，我们做了。我们制作了剪纸，并把它们作为礼物送给老人们。

sentences.en: A How can festivals bring us together?
sentences.zh: 节日如何将我们聚在一起？

sentences.en: 🟠 Let's talk
Mike and Matt are having breakfast. Listen and write T (True) or F (False). 🎧
sentences.zh: 迈克和马特正在吃早饭。听录音，写T（正确）或F（错误）。🎧

sentences.en: Matt knows about mooncakes. ( )
Mike's father bought the mooncakes. ( )
Mike: How was your Mid-Autumn Festival holiday, Binbin?
sentences.zh: 迈克：彬彬，你的中秋节假期过得怎么样？

sentences.en: Binbin: It was great! My family and I had a really nice day.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：很棒！我和家人度过了非常美好的一天。

sentences.en: Mike: What did you do? Did you take a trip?
sentences.zh: 迈克：你们做了什么？你们去旅行了吗？

sentences.en: Binbin: No, we didn't. My aunt's family visited us.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：没有。我姑姑一家来看我们了。

sentences.en: Mike: Did you enjoy some mooncakes and fruit. Grandpa told us some stories about the festival.
Binbin: Yes, we did. We enjoyed some mooncakes and fruit. Grandpa told us some stories about the festival.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：是的，我们吃了。我们品尝了月饼和水果。爷爷还给我们讲了一些关于这个节日的故事。

sentences.en: Mike: Wow! Can I join you next year?
sentences.zh: 迈克：哇！明年我可以加入你们吗？

sentences.en: Binbin: Sure. You can also join us for the Spring Festival. We can paste fu and eat jiaozi together.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：当然可以。你也可以来和我们一起过春节。我们可以一起贴福字，吃饺子。

sentences.en: Mike: Great! I can't wait!
sentences.zh: 迈克：太好了！我迫不及待了！

sentences.en: What did Binbin do in the Mid-Autumn Festival?
sentences.zh: 彬彬在中秋节做了什么？

sentences.en: What did you do in the last Mid-Autumn Festival?
sentences.zh: 你上次中秋节做了什么？

sentences.en: 🟠 Ask and answer
Think of what you did last Teachers' Day. Then talk with your partner.
sentences.zh: 想想你上次教师节做了什么，然后和同伴交流。

sentences.en: Did you draw pictures for our teachers?
sentences.zh: 你为我们的老师画画了吗？

sentences.en: No, I didn't. I took some photos. Did you make cards for our teachers?
sentences.zh: 没有。我拍了一些照片。你为我们的老师做卡片了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I did.
T or F:
F
F
What did Binbin do in the Mid-Autumn Festival? Binbin's aunt's family visited them. They enjoyed mooncakes and fruit. Grandpa told them some stories about the festival.
sentences.zh: 彬彬的中秋节：姑姑一家来做客，他们品尝了月饼和水果，爷爷给大家讲了关于节日的故事。

sentences.en: What did you do in the last Mid-Autumn Festival? I had a family dinner and enjoyed mooncakes with my family. We watched the moon together.
sentences.zh: 上次中秋节我和家人吃了团圆饭，一起品尝了月饼，还一起赏月。

sentences.en: Ask and answer
sentences.zh: 示例： Did you draw pictures for our teachers? No, I didn't. I made a card for my teacher. Did you sing a song for your teachers? Yes, I did. My teacher was very happy.

sentences.en: 3 Prepare your snapshots.
Chen Jie and Liu Xin played the pipa to greet the old people.
sentences.zh: 陈洁和刘鑫弹奏琵琶来欢迎老人们。

sentences.en: Mike and John did wonderful kung fu. What a great show!
sentences.zh: 迈克和约翰表演了精彩的功夫。真是一场精彩的演出！

sentences.en: 4 Present your snapshots in class.
sentences.zh: 在课堂上展示你的精彩瞬间。

sentences.en: These are snapshots from ...
sentences.zh: 这些是来自……的精彩瞬间。

sentences.en: Self-assessment
I can say what people do in festivals or big events.
sentences.zh: 我能说出人们在节日或大型活动中所做的事情。

sentences.en: I can describe family activities during traditional Chinese festivals.
sentences.zh: 我能描述传统中国节日期间的家庭活动。

sentences.en: I can share ideas about what brings people together.
sentences.zh: 我能分享关于是什么将人们聚在一起的想法。

sentences.en: I can order and write about things I did in a festival or a big event.
sentences.zh: 我能按顺序写出我在节日或大型活动中所做的事情。

sentences.en: Present your snapshots

These are snapshots from our Double Ninth Festival event at school. Chen Jie and Liu Xin played the pipa to greet the old people. The old people loved it very much. Mike and John did wonderful kung fu. What a great show! We also made zongzi and sang songs together. Everyone had a great time!
sentences.zh: 这些是我们学校重阳节活动的精彩瞬间。陈洁和刘鑫弹奏琵琶来欢迎老人们。老人们非常喜欢。迈克和约翰表演了精彩的功夫，真是一场精彩的演出！我们还一起包了粽子，唱了歌。每个人都度过了美好的时光！

sentences.en: 🟠 Let's learn
My dad and I cleaned the house.
My sister and I pasted fu on the door.
sentences.zh: 我和姐姐在门上贴了福字。

sentences.en: We dressed in red.
sentences.zh: 我们穿上了红色的衣服。

sentences.en: We waited for the Spring Festival Gala.
sentences.zh: 我们等待着春节晚会的开始。

sentences.en: We counted down to the new year.
sentences.zh: 我们倒数迎接新年的到来。

sentences.en: Mike: What did you do for the Spring Festival?
Binbin: Xinxin and I pasted fu on the door.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：我和欣欣在门上贴了福字。

sentences.en: 🟠 Play a guessing game
Did you eat mooncakes?
No, we didn't.
Did you count down to 12 o'clock?
Yes, we did.

sentences.en: Reading time
The Story of Nian
Scene 1
Narrator: One night, an old man came to a village. He saw the local people running away.
sentences.zh: 旁白：一天夜里，一位老人来到一个村庄。他看到当地的村民们正在四处逃跑。

sentences.en: Old man: Excuse me, why are you running? What happened?
sentences.zh: 老人：打扰一下，你们为什么要跑？发生了什么事？

sentences.en: Villager: The monster Nian will come! Last year, it ate many animals. We are all afraid of it.
sentences.zh: 村民：怪兽"年"要来了！去年，它吃了许多动物。我们都很害怕它。

sentences.en: Old man: Wait! I have a good idea. I can help you!
sentences.zh: 老人：等等！我有一个好主意。我能帮助你们！

sentences.en: Villager: The monster is very strong. You should run away to the mountains with us!
sentences.zh: 村民：这个怪兽非常强大。你应该和我们一起逃到山里去！

sentences.en: Old man: No. I will stay alone in the village and face Nian.
sentences.zh: 老人：不。我会独自留在村子里面对"年"。

sentences.en: Scene 2
Narrator: The old man stayed in the village. Then, at midnight, the monster came.
sentences.zh: 旁白：老人留在了村子里。然后，在午夜时分，怪兽来了。

sentences.en: Nian: What is that red paper on the doors and windows? I hate the colour red! Why are the windows so bright? I hate bright lights!
sentences.zh: 年：门窗上贴的是什么红色的纸？我讨厌红色！为什么窗户这么亮？我讨厌强光！

sentences.en: Old man: Aha! He looks worried.
sentences.zh: 老人：啊哈！它看起来很担心。

sentences.en: Narrator: Then the old man set off fireworks. Bang! Bang! Bang!
sentences.zh: 旁白：然后老人点燃了烟花。砰！砰！砰！

sentences.en: Nian: Oh no! I hate loud noises! No, no!
sentences.zh: 年：不好了！我讨厌巨大的声响！不，不要！

sentences.en: B How can big events bring us together?
sentences.zh: 大型活动如何将我们聚在一起？

sentences.en: 🟠 Let's talk
Binbin, Chen Jie and Amy are talking about last weekend. Listen and answer. 🎧
sentences.zh: 彬彬、陈洁和艾米正在谈论上个周末的事。听录音并回答。🎧

sentences.en: Chen Jie: Hi, Binbin. How was your weekend?
sentences.zh: 陈洁：嗨，彬彬。你的周末过得怎么样？

sentences.en: Binbin: Great! I went to a science fair. I really liked it.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：很棒！我去了科学展。我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: Amy: What did you like about it?
sentences.zh: 艾米：你喜欢科学展的哪些方面？

sentences.en: Binbin: I talked to some scientists. I also saw a robot. It looked like Robin. Maybe Robin can meet it one day.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：我和一些科学家交谈了。我还看到一个机器人，它长得像罗宾。也许罗宾有一天能见到它。

sentences.en: Chen Jie: I hope so.
What did Binbin do last weekend?
Did Robin go with Binbin?
sentences.zh: 罗宾和彬彬一起去了吗？

sentences.en: Chen Jie: How was your weekend, Amy?
sentences.zh: 陈洁：艾米，你的周末过得怎么样？

sentences.en: Amy: It was great. My mother and I went to a marathon on Sunday. She worked as a volunteer. I watched the race.
sentences.zh: 艾米：很棒。我妈妈和我周日去看了马拉松比赛。她做了一名志愿者。我观看了比赛。

sentences.en: Chen Jie: What did you like about it?
sentences.zh: 陈洁：你喜欢比赛的哪些方面？

sentences.en: Amy: I liked watching the runners. They ran very fast. I cheered for them.
sentences.zh: 艾米：我喜欢看选手们跑步。他们跑得非常快。我为他们加油助威。

sentences.en: Binbin: Nice! And you, Chen Jie? What did you do last weekend?
sentences.zh: 彬彬：很棒！那你呢，陈洁？你上周末做了什么？

sentences.en: Chen Jie: I joined an online book fair. I liked it very much.
sentences.zh: 陈洁：我参加了一个线上书展。我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: Binbin: What did you like about it?
sentences.zh: 彬彬：你喜欢书展的哪些方面？

sentences.en: Chen Jie: We shared ideas and talked about different books online.
sentences.zh: 陈洁：我们在网上分享想法，讨论不同的书籍。

sentences.en: Binbin: That sounds fun!
Did Amy and Chen Jie like the events?
sentences.zh: 艾米和陈洁喜欢这些活动吗？

sentences.en: What did they like about them?
sentences.zh: 她们喜欢这些活动的哪些方面？

sports meet

sentences.en: Unit 3 Healthy life
What is a healthylifestyle?

sentences.en: In this unit, youwill talk about illnesses and ways to stay healthy.
sentences.zh: 在本单元中，你将谈论疾病和保持健康的方法。

sentences.en: You will describehealth problems and healthy lifestyles.
sentences.zh: 你将描述健康问题和健康的生活方式。

sentences.en: You will read andidentify a student's problem and its solution in a story.
sentences.zh: 你将阅读故事，找出一名学生的问题及其解决办法。

sentences.en: You will writesuggestions to help friends with their problems.
sentences.zh: 你将写出建议，帮助朋友解决问题。

sentences.en: 【Read and write T (True) or F (False)】
📌 1. Liu Jia had a runny nose and felt unhappy. ( F )
sentences.zh: 📌 1. 刘佳流鼻涕并且感到不开心。（F）

sentences.en: ✗ Wrong: Liu Jia was crying and feeling down — not having a runny nose.
sentences.zh: ✗ 错误：原文是她在哭泣，心情低落，并非流鼻涕。

sentences.en: 📌 2. Liu Jia shared her feelings with Miss White. ( T )
sentences.zh: 📌 2. 刘佳与怀特老师分享了她的感受。（T）

sentences.en: ✅ Correct
📌 3. Liu Jia often makes video calls with her friend now. ( T )
sentences.zh: 📌 3. 刘佳现在经常与她的朋友进行视频通话。（T）

sentences.en: ✅ Correct
📌 4. Liu Jia called Miss White and thanked her. ( F )
sentences.zh: 📌 4. 刘佳打电话给怀特老师并向她道谢。（F）

sentences.en: ✗ Wrong: Liu Jia wrote a letter to thank Miss White — not a phone call.
sentences.zh: ✗ 错误：刘佳是写信感谢的，而非打电话。

sentences.en: 【Read the text again and fill in the blanks】
Problem: Liu Jia's good friend moved to another city.
sentences.zh: 问题：刘佳的好朋友___搬___到了另一个城市。

sentences.en: 【Solutions】
├─ Think about happy things.
├─ Call her friend or send her emails.
sentences.zh: ├─ 给___她的朋友___打电话___或___发___邮件。

sentences.en: ├─ Do some exercise.
└─ Join after-school clubs and make new friends.
sentences.zh: └─ 参加课外___兴趣小组___并结交___新朋友___。

sentences.en: 【Write some suggestions】
🤧 Picture 1: Child with a cold
You should rest at home and drink more water.
sentences.zh: 你应该在家休息并多喝水。

sentences.en: Then you will feel better soon.
sentences.zh: 这样你很快就会好起来。

sentences.en: 😤 Picture 2: Child feeling upset
sentences.zh: 😤 图二：情绪低落/生气的孩子

sentences.en: You should think about happy things and talk to your friends.
sentences.zh: 你应该多想想开心的事，和朋友聊聊天。

sentences.en: Then you will feel happy again.
sentences.zh: 这样你就会重新快乐起来。

sentences.en: 🐰 Picture 3: Child alone with pet
sentences.zh: 🐰 图三：独自陪宠物的孩子

sentences.en: You should join some clubs and make new friends.
sentences.zh: 你应该参加一些兴趣小组并结交新朋友。

sentences.en: Then you can have fun with them.
sentences.zh: 这样你就可以和他们一起开心了。

sentences.en: Mike has a runny nose. （ ）
Mike should go back home. （ ）
📞👦 Mike: Hello?
📞🧒 Binbin: Hi, Mike. It's Binbin. I'm going to the science museum tomorrow. Are you coming?
sentences.zh: 📞🧒 彬彬（Binbin）：嗨，迈克（Mike）。我是彬彬（Binbin）。我明天要去科学博物馆。你来吗？

sentences.en: 📞👦 Mike: I'm afraid not, Binbin. I have a bad cold.
sentences.zh: 📞👦 迈克（Mike）：恐怕不行，彬彬（Binbin）。我得了重感冒。

sentences.en: 📞🧒 Binbin: Oh dear! How do you feel?
sentences.zh: 📞🧒 彬彬（Binbin）：哦，不！你感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: 📞👦 Mike: I feel ill. My head hurts and I have a runny nose.
sentences.zh: 📞👦 迈克（Mike）：我感觉不舒服。我头痛而且流鼻涕。

sentences.en: 📞🧒 Binbin: I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe you should see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 📞🧒 彬彬（Binbin）：听到这个我很遗憾。也许你应该去看医生。

sentences.en: 📞👦 Mike: I know. My mum is going to take me to hospital this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 📞👦 迈克（Mike）：我知道。我妈妈今天下午要带我去医院。

sentences.en: 📞🧒 Binbin: That's good. Take care and get well soon!
sentences.zh: 📞🧒 彬彬（Binbin）：那很好。保重，祝你早日康复！

sentences.zh: 📞👦 迈克（Mike）：我知道。我妈妈今天下午要带我去医院。

sentences.en: 📞🧒 Binbin: That's good. Take care and get well soon!
sentences.zh: 📞🧒 彬彬（Binbin）：那很好。保重，祝你早日康复！

Help others when they need you.

Spend time with your family.

👧😷 She has a cough.

🖐️✋ 1. My name is Right Hand. This is my twin brother, Left Hand.
sentences.zh: 🖐️✋ 1. 我的名字叫右手（Right Hand）。这是我的双胞胎兄弟，左手（Left Hand）。

sentences.en: 🧒🍎 2. One day, our master didn't wash us and ate his food. He felt ill the next day. Now he washes us before every meal.
sentences.zh: 🧒🍎 2. 有一天，我们的主人没有洗手就吃东西了。他第二天感觉不舒服。现在他每次吃饭前都会洗手。

sentences.en: 🤧🧴 3. On another day, our master had a bad cold. He had a runny nose and a cough. We wiped his nose and covered his mouth with a tissue. We're important for his physical health.
sentences.zh: 🤧🧴 3. 又有一天，我们的主人得了重感冒。他流鼻涕还咳嗽。我们帮他擦鼻子，并用纸巾捂住他的嘴巴。我们对他的身体健康很重要。

sentences.en: 🎨📚 4. We're also important for his mental and social health. One day, our master felt unhappy. But we helped him make handicrafts. He felt happy again.
sentences.zh: 🎨📚 4. 我们对他的心理健康和社交健康也很重要。有一天，我们的主人感到不开心。但我们帮助他制作了手工艺品。他又开心起来了。

sentences.en: 【Section Title】 How can we stay healthy?
sentences.zh: 【板块标题】 我们怎样保持健康？

sentences.en: 【Let's talk】
🎧 Binbin and Sarah meet in front of the library. Listen and choose.
sentences.zh: 🎧 彬彬和萨拉在图书馆前相遇。请听录音并选择答案。

sentences.en: 【Listening Questions】
1️⃣ What are Binbin and Sarah preparing for?
sentences.zh: 1️⃣ 彬彬和萨拉在为什么做准备？

sentences.en: A. Today's class talk.
B. Next week's class talk.
✅ Correct answer: B
C. A test.
2️⃣ What does Binbin think of the website?
sentences.zh: 2️⃣ 彬彬对那个网站有什么看法？

sentences.en: A. Very good.
B. Not good enough.
✅ Correct answer: B
C. Not good.
【Dialogue】
👩‍🏫 Miss White: Class now we're going to discuss health.
sentences.zh: 👩‍🏫 怀特老师：全班同学，现在我们来讨论健康这个话题。

sentences.en: 👩‍🏫 Miss White: First, what is health?
sentences.zh: 👩‍🏫 怀特老师：首先，什么是健康？

sentences.en: 🧒 Chen Jie: Health is having a good body and feeling happy.
sentences.zh: 🧒 陈洁：健康就是拥有好的身体状况，并且感到快乐。

sentences.en: 👩‍🏫 Miss White: Good, Chen Jie.
sentences.zh: 👩‍🏫 怀特老师：陈洁，说得很好。

sentences.en: 👩‍🏫 Miss White: So, how can we live a healthy life?
sentences.zh: 👩‍🏫 怀特老师：那么，我们怎样才能过上健康的生活呢？

sentences.en: 👧 Sarah: We need to eat healthy food.
sentences.zh: 👧 萨拉：我们需要吃健康的食物。

sentences.en: 👧 Sarah: We should exercise too.
sentences.zh: 👧 萨拉：我们也应该锻炼身体。

sentences.en: 👩‍🏫 Miss White: That's right. What do you think, Binbin?
sentences.zh: 👩‍🏫 怀特老师：说得对。彬彬，你怎么想？

sentences.en: 🧒 Binbin: I think our family and friends are also important for a healthy life.
sentences.zh: 🧒 彬彬：我认为家人和朋友对健康的生活同样重要。

sentences.en: 🧒 Chen Jie: Yes, it's always good to talk to our family and friends.
sentences.zh: 🧒 陈洁：是的，和家人与朋友交谈总是有益处的。

sentences.en: 👩‍🏫 Miss White: Good job, everyone!
sentences.zh: 👩‍🏫 怀特老师：大家都做得很好！

sentences.en: 【Post-class Thinking】
❓ What are the students' answers to Miss White's second question?
sentences.zh: ❓ 学生们对怀特老师第二个问题的回答是什么？

sentences.en: ❓ Do you agree with them?
【Discuss and make a mind map】
🧠 Central Word: Healthy life
sentences.zh: 🧠 思维导图中心词：健康的生活

sentences.en: 【Mind Map Branches】
├─ Sleep well.
├─ Eat healthy food.
├─ Drink enough water.
└─ Take care of your eyes and teeth.
sentences.zh: └─ 照顾好你的眼睛和牙齿。

sentences.en: 【Model Sentences】
🙋 How can we live a healthy life?
sentences.zh: 🙋 我们怎样才能过上健康的生活？

sentences.en: 💬 We need to eat healthy food.
sentences.zh: 💬 我们需要吃健康的食物。

sentences.en: 💬 We should sleep well. And we can ...
sentences.zh: 💬 我们应该好好睡觉。而且我们还可以……

sentences.en: 👨‍👩‍👧 5. Our master also cooked food for his parents and sister. They thanked him and said, "You have really great hands!"
sentences.zh: 👨‍👩‍👧 5. 我们的主人还为他的父母和妹妹做了饭。他们感谢他并说："你真的有一双了不起的手！"

sentences.en: 🏅🤜🤛 6. We're important for our master and his friends. He uses us to give them a high five.
sentences.zh: 🏅🤜🤛 6. 我们对我们的主人和他的朋友们很重要。他用我们来和他们击掌。

sentences.en: 🖐️✨ We really are helping hands!
sentences.zh: 🖐️✨ 我们真的是一双助人的手！

sentences.en: 【Let's learn】
📋 Title: Healthy life
• Have a healthy diet. 🍎
• Don't stay up late. 🌙
• Exercise often. 🏃
• Think about happy things. 😊
• Join clubs and teams. 🏅
• Have fun with your friends and family. 👨‍👩‍👧
sentences.zh: • 和你的朋友及家人一起享受乐趣。👨‍👩‍👧

sentences.en: 【Model Question】
❓ How can we live a healthy life?
sentences.zh: ❓ 我们怎样才能过上健康的生活？

sentences.en: 【Discuss and make a plan】
💬 How can you live a healthy life? What is your plan?
sentences.zh: 💬 你怎样才能过上健康的生活？你的计划是什么？

sentences.en: 👧 Questioner: How can you live a healthy life?
sentences.zh: 👧 提问者：你怎样才能过上健康的生活？

sentences.en: 👩 Respondent: I can exercise often.
sentences.zh: 👩 回答者：我可以经常锻炼。

sentences.en: Jump rope or play ball games every day.
And I should ...
【Plan List】
⭐ Jump rope or play ball games every day.
【Read and write】 🎧
❓ Look at the pictures. How do they feel?
sentences.zh: ❓ 看图片。他们感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: ❓ Did you feel this way before? Why?
sentences.zh: ❓ 你以前有过这种感受吗？为什么？

sentences.en: 【Emotion Icons】
😂 Laughing happily
😟 Worried/Nervous
😒 Uncomfortable/Sick
📌 Paragraph 1
😢 Liu Jia was crying.
So Miss White asked her
What's the matter, Liu Jia? You look sad.
sentences.zh: 怎么了，刘佳？你看起来很难过。

sentences.en: Liu Jia answered
I'm feeling down.
My good friend Lucy moved to another city.
sentences.zh: 我的好朋友露西搬到了另一个城市去了。

sentences.en: 📌 Paragraph 2
Miss White listened carefully and told Liu Jia
sentences.zh: 怀特老师仔细地听完，然后告诉刘佳：

sentences.en: Think about happy things.
Call your friend or send her some emails.
sentences.zh: 给你的朋友打个电话，或者给她发几封邮件。

sentences.en: 📌 Paragraph 3
I tried that, but I still feel unhappy, said Liu Jia.
sentences.zh: 我试过了，但我仍然感到不开心，刘佳说道。

sentences.en: 📌 Paragraph 4
Miss White gave her a glass of water.
sentences.zh: 怀特老师递给她一杯水。

sentences.en: Maybe you can do some exercise.
Exercise may cheer you up!
sentences.zh: 运动也许能让你振作起来！

sentences.en: 📌 Paragraph 5
Join some after-school clubs and make new friends!
sentences.zh: 参加一些课外兴趣小组，结交新朋友！

sentences.en: You can talk and have fun with them, added Miss White.
sentences.zh: 你可以和他们交流，一起开心，怀特老师补充道。

sentences.en: 📌 Paragraph 6
I will try. Thank you, Miss White, said Liu Jia.
sentences.zh: 我会试试的。谢谢您，怀特老师，刘佳说。

sentences.en: ✉️ Liu Jia's Reply Letter
📮 Dear Miss White
I often make video calls with my friend now.
sentences.zh: 我现在经常和我的朋友进行视频通话。

sentences.en: I also joined a ping-pong club and made some new friends.
sentences.zh: 我还加入了乒乓球俱乐部，结交了一些新朋友。

sentences.en: I feel much better.
Thank you so much!
Liu Jia 😊

💰 Managing money well
❓ How can we make money work for us?
sentences.zh: ❓ 我们怎样才能让金钱为我们所用？

sentences.en: 📌 In this unit, you will
🗣️ talk about managing money.
📝 describe ways to use and manage money.
sentences.zh: 📝 描述使用和管理金钱的方法。

sentences.en: 📰 read and analyse ways of managing money in a newspaper article.
sentences.zh: 📰 阅读并分析一篇报纸文章中管理金钱的方法。

sentences.en: ✏️ write about how you are going to manage your money well.
sentences.zh: ✏️ 写一写你打算如何合理管理自己的金钱。

sentences.en: 🔵 Read and answer.
Does the author know Chen Jie?
How does Chen Jie manage her money? Mark the ways in the text.
sentences.zh: 陈洁是如何管理她的金钱的？在文中标出相关方法。

sentences.en: Which ways of managing money do you use?
sentences.zh: 你使用哪些管理金钱的方法？

sentences.en: 🔵 Read paragraph 2 again and complete the sentences.
🏷️ Topic sentence（
🏷️ Key supporting sentences（
She gets her pocket money and also gets some money for selling waste and old things.
sentences.zh: 她得到零花钱，同时也通过出售废旧物品获得一些钱。

sentences.en: She keeps her money ______________________.
🏷️ Closing sentence（
🔵 How are you going to manage your money? Write your ideas below.
sentences.zh: 你打算如何管理你的金钱？把你的想法写在下面。

sentences.en: It is important to save and spend money well. Here are my tips.
sentences.zh: 合理储蓄和消费非常重要。以下是我的建议。

sentences.en: 🔵 Read and answer（
1. Does the author know Chen Jie? Yes, she does. Chen Jie is the author's good friend.
2. How does Chen Jie manage her money?
She writes a spending plan.
She keeps her money in three money jars (spending / sharing / saving).
She uses Jar 1 to buy goods and pay for services.
She uses Jar 2 to buy gifts for family.
She uses Jar 3 to save up for big things.
3. Which ways of managing money do you use? (
sentences.zh: 开放性答案，示例) I write a spending plan and save some money every week.

sentences.en: 🔵 Complete the sentences（
Topic sentence: Chen Jie has her special ways to manage money.
Key supporting sentences:
She writes a spending plan.
She gets her pocket money and also gets some money for selling waste and old things.
She keeps her money in three money jars.Jar 1 is spending money.Jar 2 is money to share.Jar 3 is money to save.
Closing sentence: She really manages her money well!
🔵 How are you going to manage your money?（
It is important to save and spend money well. Here are my tips.
First, I am going to write a spending plan every week. Second, I will put my money into two jars — one for spending and one for saving. Finally, I will only buy things I really need.

sentences.en: 💡 Discuss and write some tips
sentences.zh: 金钱管理小贴士参考答案：

sentences.en: Save some money every month.
Think carefully before you buy.
🅰️ Why do we use money?
sentences.zh: 🅰️ 我们为什么要使用金钱？

sentences.en: 🟡 Let's talk
Mum is giving Matt his pocket money. Listen and write T (True) or F (False). 🎧
sentences.zh: 妈妈正在给马特零花钱。听录音，写T或F。🎧

sentences.en: Matt gets 25 yuan for his piggy bank. （ ）
sentences.zh: 马特得到了25元放入存钱罐。（ ）

sentences.en: Matt is going to buy some pencils. （ ）
👦 Mike: Are you counting your pocket money, Matt?
sentences.zh: 👦 迈克：马特，你在数你的零花钱吗？

sentences.en: 👦 Matt: Yes. I have three hundred and fifty-seven yuan.
sentences.zh: 👦 马特：是的。我有三百五十七元。

sentences.en: 👦 Mike: Wow, that's a lot. How are you going to spend it?
sentences.zh: 👦 迈克：哇，好多啊。你打算怎么花这些钱？

sentences.en: 👦 Matt: I'm going to buy a schoolbag.
sentences.zh: 👦 马特：我打算买一个书包。

sentences.en: 👦 Mike: Yes, you need a new one.
sentences.zh: 👦 迈克：是的，你需要一个新的。

sentences.en: 👦 Matt: I also want to buy some books.
👦 Mike: Nice. Maybe you can buy some animal books. They're interesting.
sentences.zh: 👦 迈克：不错。也许你可以买一些动物类的书，很有趣的。

sentences.en: 👦 Matt: Great idea! I like animals. Should I also buy some ice cream?
sentences.zh: 👦 马特：好主意！我喜欢动物。我也应该买一些冰淇淋吗？

sentences.en: 👦 Mike: Sure, but don't eat too much.
sentences.zh: 👦 迈克：当然可以，但是不要吃太多。

sentences.en: 👦 Matt: You're right. I won't.
sentences.zh: 👦 马特：你说得对。我不会的。

sentences.en: ❓ How much pocket money does Matt have?
❓ How is he going to spend his pocket money?
sentences.zh: ❓ 他打算怎么花他的零花钱？

sentences.en: 🟡 Think, list and say
👩 Name: Amy
🛒 Need: She is going to buy …
💭 Want: She wants to buy …
👦 How are you going to spend your pocket money?
sentences.zh: 👦 你打算怎么花你的零花钱？

sentences.en: 👧 I'm going to buy … And I also want to buy …

📋 My spending plan for the next month
Item（物品）Price（价格）Need（需要）Want（想要）Note（备注）

sentences.en: 👧 This is my spending plan for the next month. I'm going to ...
sentences.zh: 👧 这是我下个月的消费计划。我打算……

sentences.en: 👦 I like your plan.
👧 Your plan is nice. But maybe you can ...
sentences.zh: 👧 你的计划很棒。但也许你可以……

sentences.en: 📝 Self-assessment
I can tell what I need to buy from what I want to buy.
sentences.zh: 我能区分我需要买的和我想要买的东西。

sentences.en: I can make a spending plan and decide what to buy.
sentences.zh: 我能制定消费计划并决定买什么。

sentences.en: I can list what people often do with money.
sentences.zh: 我能列出人们通常用钱做的事情。

sentences.en: I can write tips about saving and spending money wisely.
sentences.zh: 我能写出关于合理储蓄和消费的小贴士。

sentences.en: 🟡 Let's learn
🛍️ People use money to do different things.
sentences.zh: 🛍️ 人们用金钱来做不同的事情。

sentences.en: 🛒 We use money to buy goods.
sentences.zh: 🛒 我们用金钱来购买商品。

sentences.en: 🍎 We buy food and drink.
👕 We buy clothes and school things.
sentences.zh: 👕 我们购买衣物和学习用品。

sentences.en: 💇 We use money to pay for services.
sentences.zh: 💇 我们用金钱来支付服务费用。

sentences.en: We need different services: haircuts, home deliveries, …
sentences.zh: 我们需要不同的服务：理发、送货上门……

sentences.en: 👧 Chen Jie（
sentences.zh: 陈洁）: How are you going to spend your pocket money?
👧 陈洁（Chen Jie）：你打算怎么花你的零花钱？

sentences.en: 👩 Amy（艾米）: I'm going to have a haircut, …
🟡 Write and discuss
💭 Where does our money go?
sentences.zh: 💭 我们的钱都花到哪里去了？

sentences.en: 🏊 go swimming / go to a dance class
sentences.zh: 🏊 去游泳 / 去上舞蹈课

sentences.en: 🎬 go to the cinema
🏥 see a doctor
🛍️ Goods（商品）
💆 Services（服务）
👦 We use money to buy goods. We buy …
sentences.zh: 👦 我们用金钱来购买商品。我们购买……

sentences.en: 👧 We use money to pay for services. We see a doctor, …
sentences.zh: 👧 我们用金钱来支付服务费用。我们去看医生……

sentences.en: Reference Answers
🎧 Let's talk
Matt gets 25 yuan for his piggy bank. （ F ）
马特（Matt）得到了25元放入存钱罐。（ F ）
sentences.zh: 💡解析：马特共有357元零花钱，并非仅得到25元存入存钱罐。

sentences.en: Matt is going to buy some pencils. （ F ）
sentences.zh: 马特打算买一些铅笔。（ F ）
💡 解析：马特打算买的是书包和书，并非铅笔。

sentences.en: ❓ How much pocket money does Matt have?
✅ Matt has three hundred and fifty-seven yuan（357元）.
sentences.zh: ✅ 马特有三百五十七元（357元）。

sentences.en: ❓ How is he going to spend his pocket money?
sentences.zh: ❓ 他打算怎么花他的零花钱？

sentences.en: ✅ He is going to buy a schoolbag and some books. He also wants to buy some ice cream.
sentences.zh: ✅ 他打算买一个书包和一些书。他还想买一些冰淇淋。

sentences.en: 📖 Reading time
1️⃣ A long time ago, people exchanged goods or services. Sometimes it was difficult to get the things they wanted.
sentences.zh: 1️⃣ 很久以前，人们通过交换商品或服务来进行贸易。有时候很难得到他们想要的东西。

sentences.en: How can you manage money well?
sentences.zh: 你怎样才能合理管理金钱？

sentences.en: By Sarah Miller
Our winner
The winner is my good friend, Chen Jie. She's a 12-year-old girl from Class One, Grade Six.
sentences.zh: 获奖者是我的好朋友陈洁。她是六年级一班的一名12岁女孩。

sentences.en: Want to look after money well?
Let's find out more ...
Manage money well

We all know it's difficult to manage our money well, but Chen Jie has her special ways. She writes a spending plan. Every week she gets her pocket money. She also gets some money for selling waste and old things. She keeps her money in three money jars. Jar 1 is spending money. She uses half this money to buy goods like books. She also uses it to pay for services like haircuts. Jar 2 is money to share. She uses this to buy gifts, for example, birthday gifts for her family. Jar 3 is money to save. Chen Jie puts money there to save up for big things like a new bike. She really manages her money well!
sentences.zh: 我们都知道合理管理金钱很难，但陈洁有她自己的特别方法。她会制定消费计划。每周她都会得到零花钱，同时也会通过出售废旧物品获得一些钱。她把钱放在三个储钱罐里。第一个罐子是消费用的钱，她用其中一半购买书籍等物品，还用来支付理发等服务费用。第二个罐子是用于分享的钱，她用这些钱购买礼物，例如给家人的生日礼物。第三个罐子是用于储蓄的钱，陈洁把钱存在那里，为购买新自行车等大件物品积攒资金。她真的很会管理自己的金钱！

sentences.zh: 你能合理管理自己的金钱吗？写信告诉我们吧！

sentences.zh: 刘老师：大家好。今天我们来谈谈我们的地球。你们在天空中能看到什么？

sentences.en: Mike: The sky is often blue in the daytime. We can see the Sun and the clouds. We can also see birds and planes.
sentences.zh: 迈克：白天天空通常是蓝色的。我们可以看到太阳和云朵，还可以看到鸟和飞机。

sentences.zh: 艾米：晚上，我们可以看到月亮和星星。

sentences.en: Mike: The sky is often blue in the daytime. We can see the Sun and the clouds. We can also see birds and planes.
sentences.zh: 迈克：白天天空通常是蓝色的。我们可以看到太阳和云朵，还可以看到鸟和飞机。

sentences.en: Amy: At night, we can see the Moon and the stars.
sentences.zh: 艾米：晚上，我们可以看到月亮和星星。

sentences.en: Mr Liu: Very good. But what can we see from outer space? Let's look at some photos from a space station.
sentences.zh: 刘老师：非常好。但从外太空我们能看到什么呢？让我们来看一些来自空间站的照片。

sentences.en: Binbin: Wow! We can see mountains, oceans and clouds. How wonderful!
sentences.zh: 彬彬：哇！我们可以看到山脉、海洋和云朵。真是太壮观了！

sentences.en: Chen Jie: There are large oceans on Earth. It looks like a big blue marble.
sentences.zh: 陈洁：地球上有广阔的海洋。它看起来像一颗巨大的蓝色弹珠。

sentences.en: Mr Liu: Right. Earth also has some beautiful names. For example, the Blue Planet and Mother Earth.
sentences.zh: 刘老师：对。地球还有一些美丽的名字，例如蓝色星球和地球母亲。

sentences.en: Mike: I like those names. I want to know more about our Mother Earth!
sentences.zh: 迈克：我喜欢这些名字。我想更多地了解我们的地球母亲！

sentences.en: What can Mike and Amy see in the sky?
sentences.zh: 迈克和艾米在天空中能看到什么？

sentences.en: What can you see in the sky?
sentences.zh: 你在天空中能看到什么？

from a plane

sentences.en: 3 Make models of Earth, the Sun and the Moon.

sentences.en: 4 Share the facts in class.
sentences.zh: 在班级里分享这些知识。

sentences.en: The Sun is very big and hot. There isn't any life on it. But it gives us light and keeps us warm.
sentences.zh: 太阳非常大而且炽热。上面没有任何生命。但它给我们光和温暖。

sentences.en: Earth goes around the Sun. So we have four seasons. Earth spins, so we have day and night. In the daytime, we can see planes, birds, ...
sentences.zh: 地球绕着太阳运转，所以我们有四个季节。地球自转，所以我们有白天和黑夜。白天，我们可以看到飞机、鸟……

sentences.en: An astronaut studies space, stars and planets. They work in ...
sentences.zh: 宇航员研究太空、星星和行星。他们在……工作。

sentences.en: 🟠 Self-assessment
I can describe what we see in the sky from Earth and from outer space.
sentences.zh: 我能描述从地球上和从外太空看到的天空中的事物。

sentences.en: I can share facts about Earth and Mars.
sentences.zh: 我能分享关于地球和火星的知识。

sentences.en: I can introduce different ways we can learn more about space.
sentences.zh: 我能介绍我们了解更多太空知识的不同方式。

sentences.en: I can write about astronauts' lives in space.
sentences.zh: 我能写一篇关于宇航员在太空中生活的文章。

sentences.en: 🟠 Let's learn
Hi, I'm Earth. I'm a planet. I travel around the Sun. Satellites travel around me.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是地球。我是一颗行星。我绕着太阳运转。卫星绕着我运转。

sentences.en: The Moon is my neighbour. It travels around me too. People can often see the Moon and the stars at night.
sentences.zh: 月亮是我的邻居。它也绕着我运转。人们晚上经常可以看到月亮和星星。

sentences.en: Earth is a planet. It travels around the Sun. The Moon ...
sentences.zh: 地球是一颗行星。它绕着太阳运转。月亮……

sentences.en: 🟠 Look, compare and say
At night, we can see the Moon and the stars from Earth. We can see some planets too.
sentences.zh: 晚上，我们可以从地球上看到月亮和星星，还可以看到一些行星。

sentences.en: In the daytime, we can see ...
Earth is a planet. It travels around the Sun. The Moon ... The Moon is Earth's neighbour. It travels around Earth. People can often see the Moon and the stars at night.
In the daytime, we can see ... In the daytime, we can see the Sun, clouds, birds and hot-air balloons.

Some fun facts about our solar system

sentences.en: English
Mercury

①
The closest planet to the Sun is not the hottest.
sentences.zh: 离太阳最近的行星并不是最热的。

sentences.en: The hottest planet is Venus. It has a temperature of about 467°C.
sentences.zh: 最热的行星是金星。它的温度约为467摄氏度。

sentences.en: ②
Jupiter's storm may be more than 300 years old.
sentences.zh: 木星上的风暴可能已经持续了300多年。

sentences.en: The name of the big storm on Jupiter is the Great Red Spot. It is wider than Earth.
sentences.zh: 木星上这场大风暴的名字叫大红斑。它比地球还宽。

sentences.en: ③
Neptune has the fastest wind in the solar system.
sentences.zh: 海王星拥有太阳系中最快的风。

sentences.en: Neptune's winds can reach over 2,000 kilometres per hour.
sentences.zh: 海王星的风速可以超过每小时2000千米。

sentences.en: Is there any water on these planets?
Very little.
So there are no fish out there.
B What do we know about Earth and its neighbours?
sentences.zh: 我们对地球及其邻居了解多少？

sentences.en: 🟠 Let's talk
Chen Jie is showing Miss White a magazine. Listen and choose. 🎧
sentences.zh: 陈洁正在给怀特老师看一本杂志。听录音并选择。🎧

sentences.en: What is the magazine about?
sentences.zh: 这本杂志是关于什么的？

sentences.en: A. Mars. B. The Sun. C. The Moon.
Why can't we live there?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不能住在那里？

sentences.en: A. It is red. B. It is too far. C. The air is thin.
Mike: Hey, Chen Jie. What are you reading about?
sentences.zh: 迈克：嘿，陈洁。你在看关于什么的内容？

sentences.en: Chen Jie: Mars.
Matt: Mars? What does it say?
sentences.zh: 马特：火星？上面写了什么？

sentences.en: Chen Jie: It talks about things on Mars.
sentences.zh: 陈洁：它介绍了火星上的事物。

sentences.en: Matt: Wow! Is there any water on Mars?
Chen Jie: Yes, there is. There is soil too.
Matt: Oh! Are there any aliens?
sentences.zh: 马特：哦！那里有外星人吗？

sentences.en: Chen Jie: I don't think so. They say there aren't any living things.
sentences.zh: 陈洁：我认为没有。据说那里没有任何生物。

sentences.en: Matt: I see.
Chen Jie: Look! This is the sunrise on Mars.
sentences.zh: 陈洁：看！这是火星上的日出。

sentences.en: Mike: How beautiful! I really want to travel to Mars.
sentences.zh: 迈克：多美啊！我真的很想去火星旅行。

sentences.en: Chen Jie: Maybe you can go one day. China already put a rover on Mars. We learn more about the "red planet" every year.
sentences.zh: 陈洁：也许有一天你可以去。中国已经在火星上放置了一辆探测车。我们每年都在更多地了解这颗"红色星球"。

sentences.en: What is on Mars?
What else do you know about Mars?
sentences.zh: 关于火星，你还知道什么？

sentences.en: 🟠 Look and role-play
What can you see in the sky?
sentences.zh: 你在天空中能看到什么？

sentences.en: I can see Earth and the Sun.
Is there any water on Mars?
Yes, there is.
Ask more questions to the rover.
sentences.zh: 向探测车提出更多问题。

sentences.en: 1. What is the magazine about? A. Mars.
2. Why can't we live there? C. The air is thin.
What is on Mars? There is water and soil on Mars. There is also a beautiful sunrise on Mars.
What else do you know about Mars? Mars is called the "red planet." China put a rover on Mars to explore it.
Role-play（
sentences.zh: 更多问题示例）: — Is there any air on Mars? — No, there isn't enough air for people to breathe. — Are there any plants on Mars? — No, there aren't any plants on Mars.

sentences.en: ④
Saturn has over ten moons.
It may have more! Scientists are still looking for them.
sentences.zh: 它可能还有更多！科学家们仍在寻找它们。

sentences.en: Are there any footprints on the Moon? How old are they?
sentences.zh: 月球上有脚印吗？它们有多少年了？

sentences.en: ⑤
Footprints on the Moon could stay there for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 月球上的脚印可以在那里保留很长时间。

sentences.en: They could be there for thousands of years!
sentences.zh: 它们可能会在那里保留数千年！

sentences.en: ⑥
There are thousands of pieces of space junk floating around Earth.
sentences.zh: 有数千块太空垃圾漂浮在地球周围。

sentences.en: Space junk is man-made objects left in space. And the number is growing!
sentences.zh: 太空垃圾是遗留在太空中的人造物体。而且数量还在不断增加！

sentences.en: What other facts do you know?
sentences.zh: 你还知道哪些趣味知识？

sentences.en: Are there any footprints on the Moon? How old are they? Yes, there are footprints on the Moon. They are over 50 years old. Astronauts left them when they visited the Moon.
What other facts do you know? Mars is called the "red planet." The Sun is a star, not a planet. Earth is the only planet with life.
🟠 Let's learn
We explore space in different ways.
sentences.zh: 我们用不同的方式探索太空。

sentences.en: We can look into space with telescopes.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用望远镜观测太空。

sentences.en: Astronauts go into space.
They use a spaceship to fly there.
sentences.zh: 他们乘坐宇宙飞船飞往太空。

sentences.en: Some astronauts live for months on a space station.
sentences.zh: 一些宇航员在空间站上生活数月。

sentences.en: How can we explore space?
There are many ways. We can ...
sentences.zh: 有很多种方式。我们可以……

sentences.en: 🟠 Look, think and talk
What do people use to explore space?
sentences.zh: 人们用什么来探索太空？

sentences.en: We use telescopes, ...
What is man-made in the picture?
The space station, ...
How can we explore space? There are many ways. We can ... We can use telescopes to look into space. Astronauts can go into space by spaceship. They can live and work on a space station.
What do people use to explore space? We use telescopes, spaceships, rovers and space stations to explore space.
What is man-made in the picture? The space station, the spaceship, the rover and the satellite are man-made.
🟠 Read and write 🎧
Do you know any Chinese astronauts? List their names.
sentences.zh: 你认识哪些中国宇航员？列出他们的名字。

sentences.en: What do you know about an astronaut's life in space?
sentences.zh: 关于宇航员在太空中的生活，你了解什么？

sentences.en: What do astronauts do?
Chinese astronauts are called taikonauts. Their life in space is special.
sentences.zh: 中国宇航员被称为太空人。他们在太空中的生活很特别。

sentences.en: The taikonauts get up early in the morning. But getting ready is different. They can't use water to wash their faces. So taikonauts have to use a wet cloth. They brush their teeth with a special toothpaste and have to "eat" it!
sentences.zh: 太空人早晨早早起床。但他们的准备工作与众不同。他们不能用水洗脸，所以太空人必须用湿布擦脸。他们用特殊牙膏刷牙，并且必须把它"吃"掉！

sentences.en: Each day the taikonauts are very busy. They do a lot of work. For example, they grow vegetables and rice. Sometimes, they also give classes to children and answer questions about space.
sentences.zh: 太空人每天都非常忙碌。他们要做很多工作。例如，他们种植蔬菜和水稻。有时，他们还给孩子们上课并回答关于太空的问题。

sentences.en: It is hard work. The taikonauts must stay healthy. Every afternoon they do exercise to keep healthy and strong. But their job is also very interesting. They can see the sunrise and sunset 16 times a day. The view is amazing! There is no other job like this one.
sentences.zh: 这是一项艰苦的工作。太空人必须保持健康。他们每天下午锻炼，以保持健康和强壮。但他们的工作也非常有趣。他们每天能看到16次日出和日落。景色令人叹为观止！没有任何其他工作能与之相比。

How can we all help Mother Earth? We are running a competition to find some helpful ideas from our readers. Please write to us and let us know your ideas and tips. Thank you.
sentences.zh: 我们如何帮助地球母亲？我们正在举办一场征文活动，向读者征集有益的想法。请给我们写信，告诉我们你的想法和建议。谢谢。

sentences.en: Sincerely,
Editor
Dear Editor,
We are running out of resources. But it is not too late. We can do things to change this. Here are my ideas.
sentences.zh: 我们的资源正在耗尽。但现在还不算太晚。我们可以采取行动来改变这一现状。以下是我的想法。

sentences.en: Tips to save energy and resources:
sentences.zh: 节约能源和资源的建议：

sentences.en: Sincerely,
Choose the best title for each idea:
Idea 1 ( A ) — Do small things to save water.
Idea 2 ( C ) — Save electricity.
Idea 3 ( B ) — Reduce, reuse and recycle.
Think: How does a quick shower save energy? A quick shower uses less hot water. Heating water needs energy, so using less water saves more energy.
Think: How can you use air conditioners less? We can open windows to let in fresh air. We can also use fans instead of air conditioners.
Think: What are your ideas for following the "3R" rules? We can reuse old bottles as pencil holders. We can recycle old newspapers and books. We can bring our own bags when we go shopping.
Dear Editor,
We are running out of resources. But it is not too late. We can do things to change this. Here are my ideas.
Tips to save energy and resources:
Take quick showers and wash clothes together to save water.
Use LED lighting and unplug computers and TVs to save electricity.
Use both sides of paper and recycle old bottles, clothes and books.
Sincerely,
Li Ming

sentences.zh: 我能写一封信来分享节约能源的想法。

sentences.en: 演讲开头示例： At home, many things use energy. Lights, computers, air conditioners and televisions all need electricity. Where does their energy come from? It can come from wind, sunlight and water!
sentences.zh: 在家里，许多事物需要使用能源。灯、电脑、空调和电视都需要用电。它们的能源从哪里来？能源可以来自风、阳光和水！

sentences.en: 演讲结尾示例： Let us all follow the "3R" rules — reduce, reuse and recycle. Every small step helps save our Earth!
sentences.zh: 让我们都遵循"3R"原则——减少使用、重复利用和回收再利用。每一小步都有助于拯救我们的地球！

sentences.en: 🟠 Let's learn
Wind power, solar power and water power are types of green energy. They are clean and good for Mother Earth.
sentences.zh: 风能、太阳能和水能都是绿色能源。它们清洁环保，对地球母亲有益。

sentences.en: We use green energy to light, heat and cool our homes and schools. We also use it to run cars, buses and trains.
sentences.zh: 我们利用绿色能源为家庭和学校提供照明、供暖和制冷。我们还用它来驱动汽车、公共汽车和火车。

sentences.en: Our project is about green energy.
sentences.zh: 我们的项目是关于绿色能源的。

sentences.en: Wind power, solar power and water power are types of green energy. We use them to ...
sentences.zh: 风能、太阳能和水能都是绿色能源。我们用它们来……

sentences.en: 🟠 Think, write and talk
cool a room
heat a house
light a bulb
run a car
Electricity is useful. We use electricity to _______________, _______________, and _______________.
sentences.zh: 电能非常有用。我们用电能来_______________、和。

sentences.en: What can make electricity?
Electricity is useful. We use electricity to ... We use electricity to cool a room, heat a house, light a bulb and run a car.
What can make electricity? Wind power, solar power and water power can make electricity.
sentences.zh: 对话示例： — Our project is about green energy. — Wind power, solar power and water power are types of green energy. We use them to light our homes and run cars and buses.

sentences.en: Reading time
It was a sunny day. Grandpa, Binbin and Robin played outside.
sentences.zh: 那是一个晴天。爷爷、彬彬和罗宾在外面玩耍。

sentences.en: They didn't want to go back to the kitchen to cook lunch. So, what could they do?
sentences.zh: 他们不想回厨房做午饭。那么，他们能做什么呢？

sentences.en: Grandpa had an idea.
"The sun is very hot. We can use solar power to cook our lunch here," he said.
sentences.zh: "太阳非常热。我们可以在这里用太阳能来烹饪我们的午饭，"他说。

sentences.en: "Let's make a solar oven!"
sentences.zh: "我们来做一个太阳能烤箱吧！"

sentences.en: So, they did.
B How do we save energy?
🟠 Let's talk
Binbin and Mike are presenting their project. Listen and answer. 🎧
sentences.zh: 彬彬和迈克正在展示他们的项目。听录音并回答。🎧

sentences.en: What makes some rivers and lakes dry up?
sentences.zh: 是什么让一些河流和湖泊干涸？

sentences.en: Do Binbin and Mike think it's too late to change? Why?
sentences.zh: 彬彬和迈克认为改变已经太迟了吗？为什么？

sentences.en: Mrs Green: We use energy every day. But many resources are running out. What should we do?
sentences.zh: 格林老师：我们每天都在使用能源。但许多资源正在耗尽。我们应该怎么做？

sentences.en: Mike: We should save energy. Then we will use fewer resources.
sentences.zh: 迈克：我们应该节约能源。这样我们就会使用更少的资源。

sentences.en: Mrs Green: How can we save energy?
sentences.zh: 格林老师：我们怎样才能节约能源？

sentences.en: Binbin: We should change our energy use.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：我们应该改变我们的能源使用方式。

sentences.en: Mrs Green: Can you give us an example, Binbin?
sentences.zh: 格林老师：彬彬，你能举个例子吗？

sentences.en: Binbin: Sure. We can take quick showers. That will save energy and water.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：当然。我们可以快速淋浴。这样可以节约能源和水。

sentences.en: Mike: I agree. We can also use LED lighting.
sentences.zh: 迈克：我同意。我们还可以使用节能灯。

sentences.en: Binbin: And we should always unplug our computers and TVs.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：我们还应该在不用时拔掉电脑和电视的插头。

sentences.en: Mrs Green: Great! Small changes can make a big difference.
sentences.zh: 格林老师：太好了！小小的改变可以带来巨大的不同。

sentences.en: Why do we have to save energy?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么必须节约能源？

sentences.en: What did Binbin and Mike suggest?
sentences.zh: 彬彬和迈克提出了什么建议？

sentences.en: 🟠 Write and discuss
How do you save energy?
At home
At school
Other places
How can we save energy?
We can use LED lighting. We can also ...
sentences.zh: 我们可以使用节能灯。我们还可以……

sentences.en: School is over. We should turn off the lights.
We can go by bus or walk to ...
sentences.zh: 我们可以乘公共汽车或步行去……

sentences.en: 1. What makes some rivers and lakes dry up? Using too many resources and wasting water and energy make some rivers and lakes dry up.
2. Do Binbin and Mike think it's too late to change? Why? No, they don't. They think small changes can make a big difference.
Why do we have to save energy? We have to save energy because many resources are running out.
What did Binbin and Mike suggest? They suggested taking quick showers, using LED lighting and unplugging computers and TVs.

At home
At school
Other places
Turn off lights when leaving a room. Unplug computers and TVs.
Turn off the lights after class. Use both sides of paper.
Go by bus or walk instead of going by car.
"Wow! How does the box keep the heat? Why do we use black paper?" Binbin wanted to know.
sentences.zh: "哇！这个盒子是怎么保持热量的？我们为什么要用黑色的纸？"彬彬想知道答案。

sentences.en: Soon their meal was ready.
sentences.zh: 不久，他们的饭菜就做好了。

sentences.en: "The food is delicious! And we cooked with no gas or electricity! That's super cool!" said Binbin.
sentences.zh: "食物真好吃！而且我们没有用煤气或电就做好了！太酷了！"彬彬说。

sentences.en: "Sunlight is a great source of energy. It can help light our house. It can run cars. And we can use it to cook too!" said Robin.
sentences.zh: "阳光是一种很好的能源。它可以为我们的房屋提供照明，可以驱动汽车，我们还可以用它来做饭！"罗宾说。

sentences.en: "Yes, we should use energy in smart ways," said Grandpa with a smile.
sentences.zh: "是的，我们应该聪明地使用能源，"爷爷微笑着说。

sentences.en: How does the box keep the heat? The box keeps the heat by trapping sunlight inside. The black paper absorbs more heat from the sun.
Why do we use black paper? We use black paper because black absorbs more sunlight and heat than other colors.

What did Binbin and Robin learn from this experience? They learned that sunlight is a great source of energy. We can use solar power to cook food, light our homes and run cars. We should use energy in smart ways.
sentences.zh: 彬彬和罗宾从这次经历中学到了什么？ 他们了解到阳光是一种很好的能源。我们可以利用太阳能来做饭、为房屋提供照明以及驱动汽车。我们应该聪明地使用能源。

sentences.en: 🟠 Let's learn
Follow the "3R" rules to save energy and resources — every little thing helps!
sentences.zh: 遵循"3R"原则来节约能源和资源——每一件小事都有帮助！

sentences.en: Reduce
Reuse
Recycle
Use air conditioners less.
Bring our own bags to shops and markets.
Recycle bottles and boxes.
Walk more and drive less.
Recycle old clothes, toys and books.
Take quick showers.

sentences.zh: 自带购物袋去商店和市场。
回收旧衣物、玩具和书籍。

sentences.en: Let's follow the "3R" rules. We should use air conditioners less. We should ...
sentences.zh: 让我们遵循"3R"原则。我们应该少用空调。我们应该……

sentences.en: 🟠 Look, write and speak
What does this chart tell you?
REDUCE + REUSE + RECYCLE = FOR A HAPPY EARTH
sentences.zh: 减少使用 + 重复利用 + 回收再利用 = 地球更美好

sentences.en: We should reduce energy use. We can take _______________, and use _______________ less. And we can reuse _______________, or recycle old toys, _______________.
This will save more energy and resources.
sentences.zh: 这将节约更多的能源和资源。

sentences.en: To follow the "3R" rules, we should ... To follow the "3R" rules, we should reduce, reuse and recycle.
sentences.zh: 完整填空示例： We should reduce energy use. We can take quick showers, and use air conditioners less. And we can reuse our own bags, or recycle old toys, clothes and books.

sentences.en: This will save more energy and resources.
Revision: Learning in museums
Read aloud and act it out.
Miss White: What do you want to learn about, children?
sentences.zh: 怀特老师：孩子们，你们想了解什么？

sentences.en: Binbin: I want to know about space and planets.
sentences.zh: 彬彬：我想了解太空和行星。

sentences.en: Chen Jie: My sister was ill for some time. It made me sad. I want to learn more about illness.
sentences.zh: 陈洁：我妹妹病了一段时间，这让我很难过。我想更多地了解疾病。

sentences.en: Mike: I want to know more about the Chinese festivals.
sentences.zh: 迈克：我想更多地了解中国节日。

sentences.en: Miss White: Those are great ideas! What can help you learn about these things?
sentences.zh: 怀特老师：这些都是很好的想法！什么可以帮助你们了解这些事情呢？

sentences.en: Chen Jie: We can read books or use the internet.
sentences.zh: 陈洁：我们可以读书或使用互联网。

sentences.en: Mike: I want to travel to different places.
sentences.zh: 迈克：我想去不同的地方旅行。

sentences.en: Miss White: That's right. We can also learn in museums. This week, we're going to plan some museum trips.
sentences.zh: 怀特老师：说得对。我们也可以在博物馆里学习。这周，我们要计划一些博物馆之旅。

sentences.en: Students: Great!
Miss White: Which museums do you want to visit? How much money do you need? Think about these questions and make a plan.
sentences.zh: 怀特老师：你们想参观哪些博物馆？你们需要多少钱？思考这些问题并制定计划。

sentences.en: 💬 What do you want to learn more about?
Choose and discuss.
Zhang Peng: Do you have a plan for your museum trip?
sentences.zh: 张鹏：你有博物馆旅行计划吗？

sentences.en: Sarah: Yes, I'm going to visit some museums online. ______
sentences.zh: 莎拉：是的，我打算在线参观一些博物馆。______

sentences.en: Zhang Peng: That's a good idea!
Sarah: ______
Zhang Peng: I'm going to visit the Great Wall Museum.
sentences.zh: 张鹏：我打算去参观长城博物馆。

sentences.en: Sarah: Wow! But it's very far. ______
Zhang Peng: I have 100 yuan. The museum is free. But I need to take a bus and I'm going to buy some food and drink. Before that, ______ I want to look good in my photos.
sentences.zh: 张鹏：我有100元。博物馆是免费的，但我需要坐公共汽车，还要买一些食物和饮料。在此之前，______我想在照片里看起来好看一些。

sentences.en: Sarah: Ha! Ha! I want to see your photos.
sentences.zh: 莎拉：哈！哈！我想看你的照片。

选项：A. I'm saving up for a new bike now. 我现在正在攒钱买新自行车。 B. I can watch videos and even buy nice gifts online. 我可以在线观看视频，甚至购买精美礼物。 C. How much are you going to take? 你打算带多少钱？ D. I need a haircut. 我需要理发。 E. Where are you going, Zhang Peng? 张鹏，你要去哪里？

sentences.en: 💬 How do you prefer to visit museums? Why?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢如何参观博物馆？为什么？

sentences.en: 🟠 Read and write 🎧
What energy do you often use every day? Do people waste energy? How?
sentences.zh: 你每天经常使用哪种能源？人们会浪费能源吗？怎么浪费的？

sentences.en: Save energy, save our Earth!
Mother Earth is running out of resources! What should we do? Here are our top three ideas. We should all try to save energy and save our Earth!
sentences.zh: 地球母亲的资源正在耗尽！我们该怎么办？以下是我们最重要的三个建议。我们都应该努力节约能源，拯救我们的地球！

sentences.en: Idea 1
Useful tips to save water:
Take a quick shower.
Wash all your dirty clothes together, not one at a time.
sentences.zh: 把所有脏衣服一起洗，而不是一件一件地洗。

sentences.en: Wash fruit and vegetables, then use the water again.
sentences.zh: 洗完水果和蔬菜后，把水再次利用。

sentences.en: Think: How does a quick shower save energy?
sentences.zh: 思考：快速淋浴如何节约能源？

sentences.en: Idea 2
Useful tips to use less electricity:
Use LED lighting.
Turn off your TV or computer and unplug it.
sentences.zh: 关闭电视或电脑并拔掉插头。

sentences.en: Set your air conditioner to 26°C or more in summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天将空调温度设定在26摄氏度或以上。

sentences.en: Think: How can you use air conditioners less?
sentences.zh: 思考：你如何减少空调的使用？

sentences.en: Idea 3
Great tips to save and recycle resources:
sentences.zh: 节约和回收资源的好建议：

sentences.en: Use both sides of paper.
Use old bottles again. You can put noodles or pencils in them.
sentences.zh: 再次使用旧瓶子。你可以用它们来装面条或铅笔。

sentences.en: Think: What are your ideas for following the "3R" rules?
sentences.zh: 思考：你有什么遵循"3R"原则的好想法？

sentences.en: Look and answer.

sentences.zh: 图片展示了四个场景：太空科技展览、绿色能源展区、AI医生问诊界面（How do you feel? I have a bad cough. My head hurts too. Try an AI doctor!）以及机器人展览区。

sentences.en: What do you see in the pictures? Is/Are there ...? Do you like the section on space, green energy, AI or robots? Why?
sentences.zh: 图片里你看到了什么？有……吗？你喜欢太空、绿色能源、人工智能还是机器人展区？为什么？

sentences.en: Think and role-play.
You are a school newspaper reporter. Ask Binbin and John some questions.
sentences.zh: 你是一名校报记者，向彬彬和约翰提问。

sentences.en: Reporter: What did you see in the museum?
sentences.zh: 记者：你们在博物馆里看到了什么？

sentences.en: Binbin: I saw a big spaceship. I also went into a mini space station. I ...
sentences.zh: 彬彬：我看到了一艘大宇宙飞船，还进入了一个迷你太空站。我……

sentences.en: Reporter: Did you see other interesting things there?
sentences.zh: 记者：你们在那里还看到了其他有趣的东西吗？

sentences.en: Binbin: Yes. A robot dressed in a Tang suit. She pasted fu on the door. Another robot ....
sentences.zh: 彬彬：是的。一个穿着唐装的机器人，她在门上贴了"福"字。还有另一个机器人……

sentences.en: Reporter: What did you like about the museum?
sentences.zh: 记者：你们最喜欢博物馆的哪个部分？

sentences.en: John: We watched a short play about Chang'e and Houyi. Then we saw an amazing robot. He gave us a speech.
sentences.zh: 约翰：我们观看了一出关于嫦娥和后羿的短剧，然后我们看到了一个令人惊叹的机器人，他给我们发表了演讲。

sentences.en: 📖 Read and give an ending to the play. 📖
sentences.zh: 阅读并给这个剧本写一个结尾。
🎬① 🎬① 🧑‍🦳 旁白：那是中秋节。在月亮上，玉兔跑啊跳啊。然后她看到了天空中一艘巨大的飞船！ Narrator: It was the Mid-Autumn Festival. On the Moon, the Rabbit ran and jumped. Then he saw a big spaceship in the sky!

🎬② 🎬② 🐰 后羿：你好，兔子！ Houyi: Hello, Rabbit! 🐇 玉兔：嗨，后羿！欢迎你！ Rabbit: Hi, Houyi! Welcome! 🐰 后羿：谢谢你。嫦娥怎么样了？ Houyi: Thank you. How is Chang'e? 🐇 玉兔：嫦娥总是很悲伤，但她现在会好起来的。看，她来了。能有家人相伴真是太好了！ Rabbit: Chang'e is always sad, but she will be happy now. Look, here she comes. It's so good to have family around again!
🎬③ 🎬③ 🌙 嫦娥：你是怎么来到月亮上的？ Chang'e: How did you get to the Moon? 🐰 后羿：一艘飞船把我带到了这里。我们在中国有很棒的飞船。 Houyi: A spaceship brought me here. We have great spaceships in China. 🌙 嫦娥：哇！ Chang'e: Wow!

🎬④ 🎬④ 🐰 后羿：嫦娥，你来这里已经很久了。你在月亮上做了什么？ Houyi: Chang'e, you came here so long ago. What did you do on the Moon? 🌙 嫦娥：玉兔和我读书、唱民歌。但我总是想念我们在一起的日子。你在地球上做了什么？ Chang'e: Rabbit and I read books and sang folk songs. But I always thought of our days together. What did you do on Earth?

sentences.en: 🎧 Listen and fill in the blanks. Then retell your favourite part. 🤖 🎧
sentences.zh: 听录音，填写空白处。然后复述你最喜欢的部分。🤖
